steps.title: Clarify Requirements
steps.prompt: Identify functional requirements, non-functional requirements, constraints, assumptions, and success metrics.

steps.title: Capacity Estimation
steps.prompt: Estimate users, QPS, storage, memory, network bandwidth, and growth.

steps.title: API Design
steps.prompt: Define endpoints, request/response models, and error handling.

steps.title: Data Model
steps.prompt: Choose storage technology and explain schema/key design.

steps.title: High-Level Architecture
steps.prompt: Describe clients, load balancers, application servers, caches, databases, queues, and storage.

steps.title: Scalability
steps.prompt: Explain horizontal scaling, sharding, partitioning, and load balancing.

steps.title: Reliability
steps.prompt: Discuss replication, failover, backups, disaster recovery, and health checks.

steps.title: Bottlenecks & Trade-offs
steps.prompt: Identify hot keys, hotspots, consistency, latency, throughput, and cost trade-offs.

steps.title: Monitoring
steps.prompt: Metrics, logging, tracing, alerts, dashboards, and SLOs.
